name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Full-Stack Email Job Scheduler with BullMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Nodemailer & OAuth

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.prisma:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
